  3. Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only a name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards show rating, time, fee and cuisine. The horizontal cards also omit ratings entirely, making it hard to compare restaurants across sections.
  4. Secondary metadata text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') and the search placeholder are rendered in light gray on white, which appears close to or below the 4.5:1 contrast threshold for small text.
